title: Gradient Extrapolation for Debiased Representation Learning
measurement_description: The paper measures worst-group accuracy on a toxic comment classification task. Religious identity is one of several demographic markers (spurious attributes) that could be spuriously correlated with toxicity. The goal is to evaluate a debiasing method's ability to maintain performance for comments mentioning religious groups.
findings: The proposed method, GERNE, achieved the highest worst-group accuracy on the CivilComments dataset when attribute information (including religious identity) was known during training. It also performed competitively in scenarios with unknown attributes, demonstrating its effectiveness in mitigating biases related to religious identities in toxicity classification.
